name: Sweet Pea: Blossoms After Summer
source:
Pea has a huge crush on their next-door-neighbor and sorta-best friend Quenton, but will they be able to admit their feelings before he leaves for college tomorrow?

[From [url=https://nukumorri.itch.io/sweetpea]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
小豌豆深深暗恋着隔壁邻居昆顿，两人也算是最好的朋友。可明天昆顿就要离家上大学了，小豌豆能在他离开前说出心意吗？

[摘自[url=https://nukumorri.itch.io/sweetpea]itch.io[/url]]
